description: On the tabletop in front of you are a few small pale clay or slime lumps, a tiny white piece near the back, and a clear plastic cup on the right. The left hand lifts and cradles one pale lump while the right hand comes in from the right to press, roll, and squeeze it against the left palm, shifting it slightly upward and then back toward the center as the kneading continues; the other lumps stay on the table nearby.
